about: Every source behind the Town app's City Hall tab: Town Meeting Day 2027 filing, the budget and tax rates for a 'your tax bill, explained' page, and bids, RFPs and contract awards. Meetings, agendas and minutes are already covered by scripts/refresh_civic.py (data/civic.json) and the newsletter's scripts/city_hall.py; nothing here refetches them. No City Hall fetcher is wired yet; 'automatable' says what a script could do.
robots: burlingtonvt.gov/robots.txt (fetched 2026-10-29; edited 2026-10-20 per an in-file comment) has two relevant groups. (1) 'User-agent: *' with Crawl-delay: 10 disallows /RSS.aspx and /rss.aspx (the feed index page), /Search*, /Map.aspx, /currentevents*, /publiclogin.aspx, /common/modules/icalendar/ and others. It does NOT disallow /RSSFeed.aspx or /Bids.aspx. (2) A named group for AI and SEO crawlers (ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Amazonbot, AhrefsBot, SemrushBot and others) repeats the * rules and adds 'expensive-endpoint blocks': /calendar.aspx, /rssfeed.aspx, /RSSFeed.aspx, /civicalerts.aspx, /bids.aspx, /Bids.aspx, /faq.aspx and /common/modules/icalendar/. Baiduspider and Yandex are fully disallowed. So RSSFeed.aspx and Bids.aspx ARE disallowed for ClaudeBot and similar bots, and allowed (with a 10 s crawl delay) for generic crawlers. A Btown Brief script should identify itself honestly (not as ClaudeBot), poll at most a few times a day, and keep 10 s or more between requests. Better still, use the city's email 'Notify Me' alerts for bids. During this research I fetched Bids.aspx, RSSFeed.aspx and RSS.aspx a handful of times by hand with a browser user agent, at the user's request. Other hosts used (burlingtonvt.api.civicclerk.com, data.burlingtonvt.gov, bsdvt.org, burlingtonelectric.com, btv.aero) are not covered by this file. Their own robots.txt files were not checked.

town_meeting_day_2027.basis: Computed from 17 V.S.A. 2681 (sixth Monday before the election, 5 pm) and the 2026 SOS calendar pattern (Jan 26, 2026); the clerk and Secretary of State have not yet posted 2027 dates. Confirm with the Clerk/Treasurer (802-865-7000) before publishing.

City Council: Central, East, North and South district seats
School commissioners: the four district seats (inferred from 2023 and 2025)
Ward clerks and inspectors of election
ballot_questions_seen: Charter change: modernizing city government (both on the Oct 26, 2026 council agenda)
town_meeting_day_2027.petition_signatures: Mayor 150 (charter); other offices 30 voters or 1%, whichever is less (17 V.S.A. 2681)
town_meeting_day_2027.candidate_list: The clerk does not appear to post a pre-election candidate list; the warning lists offices only. After the election a scanned 'Declaration of Elected Candidates' PDF is posted on /179/Election-Results. Who's Running therefore needs a records request or a call to the clerk the day after the filing deadline, plus candidates' own announcements.

tax_rates.formula: Grand list value = appraised value / 100; residential tax = GL x (education + municipal + local agreement). Commercial municipal tax uses appraised value x 1.2.
tax_rates.payments: Quarterly, due the 12th of August, November, March and June
tax_rates.fy27_status: The FY27 budget page is still labelled DRAFT; the FY26 tax resolution is the signed adopted copy.
